remarks: Welcome to Vista Tower in the desirable Glenbrook neighborhood-one of Stamford's high-rise residences offering comfort, convenience, and style. This 3rd-floor condo features 2 spacious bedrooms and 2 full bathrooms across 1,336 sq ft of sun-filled living space.  Hardwood floors add warmth and elegance, while included utilities such as heat, hot water, and trash removal add tremendous value. A dedicated parking spot ensures hassle-free city living.  Ideally located near downtown Stamford, just minutes to shopping, restaurants, Metro-North, I-95, and public transportation, this condo offers high-rise living with the friendly feel of the Glenbrook community. Don't miss your chance to make this exceptional property your new home!
